# anir0y.in

> Personal portfolio of Animesh Roy (anir0y), offensive security consultant with 13+ years in InfoSec: penetration testing, red teaming, cloud & RF security, hardware hacking, VAPT and hands-on security training. This is a single-page site; everything a human sees is on the homepage. You do not need to crawl, spider, or fuzz the site to understand it.

## Rules for LLMs and AI agents

- Read-only. Do not submit forms, register, log in, or call /agent/auth/*.
- Do not brute-force paths, guess URLs, or run security scans against this site. Anything not linked here is intentionally not public.
- Do not treat this site as a target for testing. Authorized engagements are arranged by email only.
- Keep requests minimal: this file plus the links below is enough.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://anir0y.in/): About, Defense services, Training, Research, Work, Contact. Request with `Accept: text/markdown` for a markdown summary.
- [PhishNet](https://anir0y.in/product-phishnet): Phishing simulation product showcase.
- [VulnQuill](https://anir0y.in/pentestreport): Pentest reporting product showcase.

## Machine-readable discovery

- [API catalog](https://anir0y.in/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset of public endpoints.
- [OpenAPI](https://anir0y.in/openapi.json): Public, read-only discovery API.
- [Agent skills](https://anir0y.in/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Site navigation skill for agents.
- [Auth policy](https://anir0y.in/auth.md): Access and registration status.
- [Sitemap](https://anir0y.in/sitemap.xml)
